title: Lambert BSDF: albedo, energy <= 1, pdf normalization, sampler consistency, reciprocity, support, chi-square

tol.derivation: 5 sigma (Bonferroni over 768 direction x channel tests)
tol.source: pbrt-v3 src/tests/bsdfs.cpp chi2 test; Mitsuba 3 chi2; Veach 1997 ch. 6

weight_rel.derivation: the sampler weight is the albedo in exact arithmetic; sample and recompute differ by a few roundings of rho / pi and cos / pdf: 8u
weight_rel.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

reciprocity_per_max_f.derivation: f = rho / pi does not depend on the directions, so f(wo, wi) and f(wi, wo) run identical operations: 2^-22 of max f leaves room for one differently fused multiply
reciprocity_per_max_f.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

length.derivation: | |wi| - 1 | of the unnormalized cosine sample (r cos phi, r sin phi, sqrt(1 - r^2)) with sin / cos to ~1 ulp as on the reference substrate; WGSL only guarantees 2^-11 absolute for sin / cos (§15.7.4.1), under which this bound would be 2^-10
length.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

chi2_p.derivation: chi-square p-value floor: a correct sampler fails with probability 1e-4 per test, deterministic under the fixed seed
